1. to lay down; mid. (in Hom.), to lie down.
2. to narrate (LXX, De 19:16, II Mac 7:30).
3. to choose out, hence, to enrol (as of soldiers, Hdt., Thuc., a1., v. LS, s.v.): of widows, pass., (cf. Ellic.; CGT, in l.).†
